title: memory.node.created v1
description: An EverOS memory node (episode, atomic_fact, foresight, profile, agent_case, agent_skill) appeared. Published by adapters/everos-watch, which diffs entry-id sets of the EverOS markdown memory tree. IDS AND METADATA ONLY: the payload never carries memory content (no subject, summary, text, or hashes of text). Scope map and privacy classes: memory-layer design (hearth#719, nervous-bus#115).

app_id.description: EverOS app scope (path segment 1; default_app on disk = 'default').

owner_id.description: user_id or agent_id. OMITTED when redacted=true (private app scopes, e.g. studio fan hashes).

entry_id.description: Entry id from the <!-- entry:ID --> marker; 'user' for the single-file profile (user.md); the skill dir name for agent_skill.

session_id.description: session_id recorded on the entry, when present. OMITTED when redacted=true.

md_path.description: Path of the markdown file relative to the memory root. The owner segment is replaced by '_redacted_' when redacted=true.

observed_at.description: When the watcher observed the change (RFC3339 UTC).

redacted.description: True when the app scope is private (owner_id, session_id and the owner path segment withheld).
